Every required visible word is retained and readable over the sweep with no ellipsis or clipped word. Collapsed guidance and unselected dossiers are intentionally hidden. Oversized words break across characters at the narrow enlarged-text width; the brief expressly permits that fallback, and the following line retains the remaining characters.

The complete original exact-state sweep shows distinct title/subtitle/notice, disclosure, timeline cards, severity/reason text, summary, action and footer areas. No unintended collision or occlusion is visible; closed disclosure does not leave dossier text over other content. Viewport-edge cropping is resolved by overlapping original frames; contact-sheet column cuts are not component collisions.

attributions.reason: Original state-scoped PNGs show the disabled primary control fully inside the actual viewport. Its approved side strip is a uniform interior fill, clear of label glyphs and corners, and the frozen sampler confirms full solid-color support. The sampled region belongs to the component primary button, not the outer host. Source uses PlainButtonStyle with .disabled and the intended palette background, while the actual disabled appearance is altered; source palette declarations do not override original rendered pixels. The component owns the final opaque action fill, so this is a product appearance defect (disabled-style compositing), not a mapping/environment or unsuitable-observation failure.
